0x02:incoming.notes: Turns or steps the character. The high direction bit marks running.
0x02:incoming.handler: MoveRequestPacketHandler: turns or steps the character, answered with 0x22 or 0x21

0x05:incoming.notes: Recognized and ignored until combat handling is available.
0x05:incoming.handler: IgnoredPacketHandler<T>: recognised and ignored for now (Debug log)

fields.name: Target serial
fields.description: Item or mobile selected by the client; the high bit (0x80000000) asks for the own paperdoll.

0x06:incoming.notes: A double click opens a carried container when its graphic has the Container flag, or the paperdoll of a human-bodied mobile in view range.
0x06:incoming.handler: UseRequestPacketHandler: opens a container the character carries, or a paperdoll

0x07:incoming.notes: Only a whole carried item can be lifted. Rejection sends 0x27.
0x07:incoming.handler: LiftRequestPacketHandler: picks up an item the character carries or wears, or one on the ground within 2 tiles

fields.name: Grid index
fields.description: The slot the Enhanced Client asks for in the container's grid; 0 from the classic client.

0x08:incoming.notes: Drops a held item into a carried container, onto a stack of the same kind, or on the ground within 2 tiles (destination 0xFFFFFFFF); invalid destinations bounce it back.
0x08:incoming.handler: DropRequestPacketHandler: drops the held item into a carried container, onto a carried or ground stack of the same kind, or on the ground within 2 tiles

0x09:incoming.notes: A single click shows the name over the object.
0x09:incoming.handler: LookRequestPacketHandler: shows the first tooltip line over the object (0xC1)

0x11:outgoing.notes: Version 5 status payload; fields after the basic header depend on the status version.
0x11:outgoing.handler: CharacterEnterWorldService: sends the player status in the world-entry sequence.

0x12:incoming.handler: IgnoredPacketHandler<T>: recognised and ignored for now (Debug log)

fields.name: Layer
fields.description: Layer the client suggests; the server uses the item's own

0x13:incoming.notes: Wears the held item on the own character when its layer is free and both hands fit; anything else bounces back.
0x13:incoming.handler: EquipRequestPacketHandler: puts the held item on the character, or bounces it back

0x1B:outgoing.notes: First world-entry packet; initializes the player position and map bounds.
0x1B:outgoing.handler: CharacterEnterWorldService: starts the world-entry packet sequence.

fields.name: Serial
fields.description: Entity to remove from the client.

0x1D:outgoing.notes: Removes an item or mobile from the client view.
0x1D:outgoing.handler: Outgoing packet emitted by world visibility and item handling

0x20:outgoing.notes: Updates the player mobile after world entry, and tells a teleported player where it stands.
0x20:outgoing.handler: CharacterEnterWorldService: sends the player mobile update during world entry. TeleportService: sends it to a teleported player, whose step sequence starts again.

0x21:outgoing.notes: Refuses a step and restores the client to the server position.
0x21:outgoing.handler: MoveRequestPacketHandler: rejects the step and restores the server position.

0x22:incoming.handler: IgnoredPacketHandler<T>: recognised and ignored for now (Debug log)

0x65:outgoing.notes: Sets the weather the client shows: the profile of the player's region, or dry inside a building.
0x65:outgoing.handler: WeatherService: sent at login, on a region change and when the player's weather changes; resent every minute, every game hour and after a season packet (0xBC).

fields.name: Direction
fields.description: Facing direction; bit 0x80 marks a run

0x77:outgoing.notes: Moves or turns a mobile the client already shows.
0x77:outgoing.handler: WorldViewService: sent to the players that already saw a mobile when it steps or turns.

0x24:outgoing.notes: Seven bytes for older clients; nine bytes from client 7.0.9.0. This version-dependent packet has no on-wire length header.
0x24:outgoing.handler: UseRequestPacketHandler: opens the carried container gump; BankService: opens the bank box.

fields.name: Grid index
fields.description: The item's slot (0 to 124) in the grid the Enhanced Client shows; newer client format only.

0x25:outgoing.notes: Twenty bytes before client 6.0.1.7; newer clients receive a grid byte. This version-dependent packet has no on-wire length header.
0x25:outgoing.handler: Item handlers: refresh the item after a lift or drop, or bounce it back.

0x27:outgoing.notes: Rejects a lift; the host may also send an item update to restore its position.
0x27:outgoing.handler: LiftRequestPacketHandler: reports why a lift was refused.

0x34:incoming.handler: IgnoredPacketHandler<T>: recognised and ignored for now (Debug log)

0x3C:outgoing.notes: Each item uses 19 bytes, or 20 with the grid byte for newer clients: the item's slot (0 to 124) in the grid the Enhanced Client shows.
0x3C:outgoing.handler: UseRequestPacketHandler and BankService: send the opened container contents.

0x4E:outgoing.notes: Sets the light level for one mobile.
0x4E:outgoing.handler: CharacterEnterWorldService: sends personal light during world entry.

0x4F:outgoing.notes: Sets ambient world light: the day and night cycle, dungeons and jails, or .globallight.
0x4F:outgoing.handler: CharacterEnterWorldService sends it during world entry; LightService resends it when the player's light changes.

0x53:outgoing.notes: Sent before disconnect when character creation is refused or fails.
0x53:outgoing.handler: Game: sent before disconnecting when character creation is refused or fails

0x55:outgoing.notes: Marks completion of login and world entry.
0x55:outgoing.handler: CharacterEnterWorldService: ends the login part of the world-entry sequence; only 0x5B follows.

0x5B:outgoing.notes: Sent last in the world-entry sequence with the real UTC time of the server, not the game time.
0x5B:outgoing.handler: CharacterEnterWorldService: sends the real UTC time at the end of world entry.

0x5D:incoming.notes: Selects a character slot and starts world entry.
0x5D:incoming.handler: PlayCharacterPacketHandler: brings the chosen character into the world

0x72:incoming.handler: IgnoredPacketHandler<T>: recognised and ignored for now (Debug log)

0x72:outgoing.notes: Tells the client its current war mode.
0x72:outgoing.handler: CharacterEnterWorldService: sends peace mode during world entry.

fields.name: Sequence
fields.description: Ping sequence echoed by the host.

fields.name: Worn items
fields.description: Equipment entries terminated by zero serial.

0x78:outgoing.notes: Introduces the mobile and its worn items; ends with a zero serial.
0x78:outgoing.handler: CharacterEnterWorldService: sends the player and worn items during world entry.

0x80:incoming.notes: Checks credentials and returns a realm list or denial.
0x80:incoming.handler: Login: async account check, then 0xA8 list or 0x82 denial

0x82:outgoing.notes: Rejects login with a reason code.
0x82:outgoing.handler: AccountLoginPacketHandler: denies a failed account login.

0x83:incoming.notes: Marks the selected character for deletion.
0x83:incoming.handler: DeleteCharacterPacketHandler: marks the character for deletion

0x85:outgoing.notes: Reports the result of a deletion request.
0x85:outgoing.handler: DeleteCharacterPacketHandler: reports the result of a deletion request.

0x86:outgoing.notes: Updates character slots without a full city list.
0x86:outgoing.handler: Character list update response after a character slot changes.

0x8C:outgoing.notes: Redirects to the selected realm after ticket issue.
0x8C:outgoing.handler: Login: sent after a valid 0xA0, before closing the login connection

fields.name: Unknown pattern
fields.description: Four bytes the server does not read

fields.name: Unused
fields.description: Thirty bytes the server does not read

fields.name: Race
fields.description: Race choice, sent one higher (1 for human)

fields.name: Unused
fields.description: Eight bytes the server does not read

fields.name: Appearance
fields.description: Hair, shirt, face and beard hues and styles, with unread bytes between them.

0x8D:incoming.notes: Enhanced Client creation request. Only the current 146-byte layout is parsed.
0x8D:incoming.handler: CreateCharacterEnhancedPacketHandler: creates and saves the character and starting items, then brings it into the world

0x91:incoming.notes: Consumes the one-use handoff ticket and starts the game session.
0x91:incoming.handler: Game: validates and consumes the one-use handoff ticket, then sends 0xB9 and 0xA9

0xA0:incoming.handler: Login: checks realm eligibility, issues ticket and redirects

0xA8:outgoing.notes: Lists realms eligible for the authenticated account.
0xA8:outgoing.handler: AccountLoginPacketHandler: sends eligible realms after authentication.

fields.name: Characters
fields.description: Character slot records followed by city records and flags.

0xA9:outgoing.notes: Sends saved characters and starting cities after game login.
0xA9:outgoing.handler: GameLoginPacketHandler: sends saved characters and starting cities.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Speech type; the bits 0xC0 mark encoded speech with keywords

fields.name: Language
fields.description: Three letters and a zero; anything else is read as ENU

fields.name: Keywords and text
fields.description: Plain speech: big-endian UTF-16 text, zero terminated. Encoded speech: a 12-bit keyword count, the 12-bit keyword ids, then UTF-8 text, zero terminated.

0xAD:incoming.notes: Speech typed by the player in Unicode, sent by every client. It is read leniently, since a refused packet disconnects the client: a missing terminator is accepted, a badly encoded character becomes U+FFFD and an odd language code becomes ENU. Only a truncated keyword list or more than 50 keywords is refused.
0xAD:incoming.handler: SpeechRequestPacketHandler: speech to the players in range and dot commands; the keyword ids of encoded speech reach the on_speech of the NPCs and of the scripted items.

0xB5:incoming.handler: IgnoredPacketHandler<T>: recognised and ignored for now (Debug log)

fields.name: Mode
fields.description: 0 asks to show the profile, 1 sends an edited one.

fields.name: Character serial
fields.description: The character whose profile is asked for or edited.

fields.name: Edited profile
fields.description: Only in mode 1: a command type, the text length and the UTF-16BE text.

0xB8:incoming.notes: The Enhanced Client sends it for its own character right after entering the world. Recognized and ignored for now.
0xB8:incoming.handler: IgnoredPacketHandler<T>: recognised and ignored for now (Debug log)

0xB9:outgoing.notes: Enables client features after game login.

fields.name: Play sound
fields.description: Whether the client plays the season sound.

0xBC:outgoing.notes: Sets the displayed season. The client resets its light and stops its weather on it, so 0x4F and 0x65 follow.
0xBC:outgoing.handler: CharacterEnterWorldService at world entry; SeasonService on a region change or a map change to another season, a rotation and .season, followed by 0x4F light and 0x65 weather. It is sent only when the season differs from the last one sent.

0xBD:incoming.notes: Records the client version on the session.
0xBD:incoming.handler: ClientVersionPacketHandler: records the client version on the session

0xBD:outgoing.handler: Login host: requests the client version before further processing.

0xBF/0x08:outgoing.notes: Extended command subcommand 0x08 changes the client map: sent on world entry and before the new position of a player teleported to another map.
0xBF/0x08:outgoing.handler: CharacterEnterWorldService: sends the selected map during world entry. TeleportService: sends the new map to a player teleported across maps.

0xBF:incoming.notes: Subcommand 0x10 asks for one tooltip; the others are ignored for now. Outgoing 0xBF/0x08 is a separate map subcommand.

0xC8:incoming.handler: UpdateRangePacketHandler: answers with the server's view range.

fields.name: Serials
fields.description: Objects whose tooltips are asked, 4 bytes each, at most 500.

0xD6:incoming.notes: Answered with one 0xD6 per object the character sees.

fields.name: Hardware details
fields.description: CPU memory display and video data.

0xD9:incoming.notes: Recognized and ignored for now, in every server mode; hardware data is not stored. The Enhanced Client sends it at login.
0xD9:incoming.handler: Game: IgnoredPacketHandler<T>; Login: LoginRoleIgnoredPacketHandler<T>. Both recognise and ignore it for now (Debug log)

0xE1:incoming.handler: IgnoredPacketHandler<T>: recognised and ignored for now (Debug log)

0xEF:incoming.notes: Records the client version when sent on login listeners.
0xEF:incoming.handler: LoginSeedPacketHandler; on login listeners it also records the client version, which the handoff ticket carries to the game session

fields.name: Appearance
fields.description: Hair beard clothing and city choices.

0xF8:incoming.notes: ClassicUO character creation request. Raw choices are validated before saving.
0xF8:incoming.handler: CreateCharacterPacketHandler: creates and saves the character and starting items, then brings it into the world

0xFB:incoming.handler: IgnoredPacketHandler<T>: recognised and ignored for now (Debug log)

0x03:incoming.notes: Speech typed by the player in ASCII.
0x03:incoming.handler: SpeechRequestPacketHandler: local say or in-game dot command.

fields.name: Text
fields.description: Unicode text (UTF-16 big endian), zero terminated

0xAE:outgoing.notes: Shows player speech, private command output or the MOTD in Unicode.
0xAE:outgoing.handler: Player speech, private command output and MOTD delivery.

fields.name: Serial
fields.description: Item identifier; bit 0x80000000 says an amount follows

fields.name: Y
fields.description: World Y; bit 0x8000 says a hue follows

0x1A:outgoing.notes: Shows an item on the ground to clients before 7.0.0.0.
0x1A:outgoing.handler: WorldViewService: sent to the players in range when an item is dropped, and when they come into range of it.

fields.name: Light
fields.description: Light shape (LightType) of a light source, 0 for none.

0xF3:outgoing.notes: Shows an item on the ground to clients from 7.0.0.0; 26 bytes from 7.0.9.0.
0xF3:outgoing.handler: WorldViewService: sent to the players in range when an item is dropped, and when they come into range of it.

fields.name: Cursor id
fields.description: Id the response must carry; 0 when cancelling

0x6C:outgoing.notes: Shows the target cursor, or with flags 3 takes it away.
0x6C:outgoing.handler: TargetService: sent when a target begins or is cancelled by the server.

fields.name: Serial
fields.description: Item or mobile picked, 0 for a spot

fields.name: Z
fields.description: World Z as the client sees it

fields.name: Graphic
fields.description: Static graphic, 0 for the ground or an object

0x6C:incoming.notes: The player's pick for a target cursor, or a cancel.
0x6C:incoming.handler: TargetResponsePacketHandler: completes the player's pending target.

fields.name: Range
fields.description: View range in cells, from 5 to 24

0xC8:outgoing.notes: Tells the client the server's view range.
0xC8:outgoing.handler: UpdateRangePacketHandler: sent in answer to the client's 0xC8.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Name, then ', title' when the mobile has one; zero-padded.

fields.name: Flags
fields.description: 0x01 war mode, 0x02 the viewer may take items off.

0x88:outgoing.handler: UseRequestPacketHandler: sent in answer to a double click.

fields.name: Layer
fields.description: Layer, written as 0 then the layer byte.

0x2E:outgoing.notes: Shows an item worn by a mobile.
0x2E:outgoing.handler: EquipRequestPacketHandler and the world view: sent when an item goes on; BankService: the bank box before it opens.

fields.name: Lines
fields.description: Each line: cliloc (uint), arguments length in bytes (ushort), arguments in UTF-16LE; ended by a zero cliloc.

fields.name: Revision
fields.description: The tooltip hash with bit 30 set.

0xDC:outgoing.notes: Tells the client the current tooltip revision.

fields.name: Serial
fields.description: The object the text is shown over.

0xC1:outgoing.notes: A cliloc shown by the client in its language.

0x54:outgoing.notes: Plays a sound once at a location.
0x54:outgoing.handler: SpeechService: npc.play_sound of a mobile script, to the players within 15 cells.

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: 0 moving, 1 lightning, 2 fixed at a point, 3 fixed on an object.

fields.name: Source serial
fields.description: The object the effect starts from or stays on; 0 for a point.

fields.name: Target serial
fields.description: The object a moving effect flies to; 0 otherwise.

fields.name: Graphic
fields.description: Art id of the animation; 0 for lightning or particles only.

fields.name: To X
fields.description: Where a moving effect ends; the same point otherwise.

fields.name: To Y
fields.description: Where a moving effect ends; the same point otherwise.

fields.name: To Z
fields.description: Where a moving effect ends; the same point otherwise.

fields.name: Speed
fields.description: How fast the animation plays or moves.

fields.name: Fixed direction
fields.description: 1 keeps the graphic's direction; always 1 for an effect that stays.

fields.name: Explodes
fields.description: 1 makes a moving effect explode when it arrives.

fields.name: Hue
fields.description: Hue of the graphic; 0 for none.

fields.name: Render mode
fields.description: 0 normal, 1 darken, 2 lighten, 3 lighten transparent, 4 translucent, 5 translucent colour, 6 negative, 7 negative transparent.

0xC0:outgoing.notes: Plays a graphic effect: a moving one, a lightning bolt, or an animation that stays at a point or on an object. Sent for every effect that has a graphic and for every lightning bolt, which has none; a moving effect with graphic 1, the placeholder of ModernUO scripts, counts as having no graphic. The plain 0x70 is never sent.
0xC0:outgoing.handler: EffectService: the effect module of scripts, to the players of the map within the view range of the effect; a moving effect also reaches those in range of its destination.

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: 0 moving, 1 lightning, 2 fixed at a point, 3 fixed on an object.

fields.name: Source serial
fields.description: The object the effect starts from or stays on; 0 for a point.

fields.name: Target serial
fields.description: The object a moving effect flies to; 0 otherwise.

fields.name: Graphic
fields.description: Art id of the animation; 0 for lightning or particles only.

fields.name: To X
fields.description: Where a moving effect ends; the same point otherwise.

fields.name: To Y
fields.description: Where a moving effect ends; the same point otherwise.

fields.name: To Z
fields.description: Where a moving effect ends; the same point otherwise.

fields.name: Speed
fields.description: How fast the animation plays or moves.

fields.name: Fixed direction
fields.description: 1 keeps the graphic's direction; always 1 for an effect that stays.

fields.name: Explodes
fields.description: 1 makes a moving effect explode when it arrives.

fields.name: Hue
fields.description: Hue of the graphic; 0 for none.

fields.name: Render mode
fields.description: 0 normal, 1 darken, 2 lighten, 3 lighten transparent, 4 translucent, 5 translucent colour, 6 negative, 7 negative transparent.

fields.name: Explode particle
fields.description: Particle effect played when a moving effect arrives; 1 for an effect that stays.

fields.name: Explode sound
fields.description: Sound played when a moving effect arrives.

fields.name: Particle serial
fields.description: The object the particles belong to; 0 for a moving effect or a point.

fields.name: Layer
fields.description: Body part the particles are shown at: 0 head, 1 right hand, 2 left hand, 3 waist, 4 left foot, 5 right foot, 7 centre of the feet, 255 none.

0xC7:outgoing.notes: The hued effect (0xC0) followed by the particle fields. Sent only to the Enhanced Client, for an effect that has a particle id; every other client gets 0xC0, or nothing when the effect has no graphic.
0xC7:outgoing.handler: EffectService: the effect module of scripts, to the Enhanced Clients in range.

fields.name: Serial
fields.description: Gump serial, unique per gump sent.

fields.name: Type id
fields.description: Gump type id: FNV-1a of the gump id.

fields.name: Layout length
fields.description: Bytes of the layout, NUL included.

fields.name: Layout and strings
fields.description: The layout commands (such as { resizepic 0 0 9200 300 400 }) and their NUL; then a ushort string count and each string as a ushort length in characters and UTF-16 big-endian text.

0xB0:outgoing.notes: Opens a gump on clients before 5.0.0a. The layout refers to the strings by index.
0xB0:outgoing.handler: GumpService: opens a gump when the client is older than 5.0.0a.

fields.name: Serial
fields.description: Gump serial, unique per gump sent.

fields.name: Type id
fields.description: Gump type id: FNV-1a of the gump id.

fields.name: Layout and strings
fields.description: The zlib layout; then a uint string count, a uint compressed table length plus 4 (0 with no strings), a uint plain table length and the zlib table (each string as ushort length and UTF-16 big-endian text).

0xDD:outgoing.notes: Opens a gump on clients from 5.0.0a, compressed.
0xDD:outgoing.handler: GumpService: opens a gump on a client from 5.0.0a.

fields.name: Type id
fields.description: Type id of the gump answered.

fields.name: Button
fields.description: Button pressed; 0 when the gump was closed.

fields.name: Switch count
fields.description: Checkboxes and radios that are on.

fields.name: Switches and texts
fields.description: Switch ids (uint each); then a uint text count and each text entry as ushort id, ushort length in characters and UTF-16 big-endian text.

0xB1:incoming.notes: The answer is dropped when the gump was not sent, or offers no such button, switch or text entry, or a text is longer than 239 characters.
0xB1:incoming.handler: GumpResponsePacketHandler: hands the answer to GumpService, which checks it and calls the gump.

fields.name: Type id
fields.description: Type id of the gump to close.

0xBF/0x04:outgoing.notes: Extended command subcommand 0x04 closes a gump.
0xBF/0x04:outgoing.handler: GumpService: closes a gump replaced by one with the same id, or closed by the server.

0x6D:outgoing.notes: Plays a music track on the client.
0x6D:outgoing.handler: MusicService: the track of the player's region, else its map's, when it changes; .music plays one.
